name: QwenPaw Terminal
description: Terminal de comando integrado ao QwenPaw com acesso total ao sistema. Execute shell commands, scripts, gerencie processos e navegue pelo filesystem diretamente pelo menu do QwenPaw.
author: dev-agent

tools.name: terminal_exec
tools.description: Execute a shell command and return its output (non-interactive)

tools.name: terminal_cwd
tools.description: Get or set the current working directory of the terminal

tools.name: terminal_which
tools.description: Check if a command or program is available on the system PATH
